description: Input metrics for pre-95 experiments, frozen during paper figure cleanup.
comparison_inclusion_note: Current plotting excludes non-holdout Phase-78 windows, repeated Phase-79 historic rows, and records missing a nonspill metric or spill-screen result. Synthetic infinity is a recorded no-spill failure and remains eligible.
spill_column_note: For source tables without total_spill_af, the original zero-spill pass test is encoded as 0 (pass) or infinity (fail); this synthetic value is not a measured spill volume.
